categories.main_business_segments: TD SYNNEX operates through three main geographic business segments: the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific & Japan (APJ). Each segment distributes a broad portfolio of IT products and solutions, including Endpoint Solutions and Advanced Solutions portfolios, and provides systems design and integration services. The company previously operated in two segments (Technology Solutions and Concentrix), but after the separation of Concentrix and the merger with Tech Data, it realigned to the current three-region structure.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: TD SYNNEX's core operations center on the distribution of IT hardware, software, and systems, including personal computing devices, peripherals, mobile phones, printers, servers, datacenter infrastructure, hybrid cloud, security, networking, and storage solutions. The company leverages highly automated, regionally dispersed distribution centers, proprietary IT systems, and advanced logistics, as well as systems design and integration capabilities such as build-to-order and configure-to-order assembly, thermal and power testing, and cloud platform services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves over 150,000 active reseller customers globally, including value-added resellers (VARs), corporate and government resellers, system integrators, direct marketers, retailers, and managed service providers (MSPs). End markets include large enterprises, SMBs, government agencies, healthcare, and individual consumers, with specialized solutions for verticals such as government and healthcare.
categories.geographic_coverage: TD SYNNEX has a global footprint, with operations in the Americas, Europe, and Asia-Pacific & Japan. Approximately 45% of its 2022 revenue was generated outside the United States, with principal markets including the US, Canada, Latin America, most major European countries, and key Asia-Pacific markets. The company operates 194 facilities worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: TD SYNNEX operates primarily as a downstream distributor and solutions aggregator within the IT supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between over 1,500 OEM suppliers and a large, fragmented base of reseller and retail customers, providing value-added distribution, logistics, integration, and supply chain management services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include investing in high-growth technologies such as hybrid cloud, security, analytics/IoT, hyperscale infrastructure, and services; expanding technology-as-a-service and recurring revenue models; driving digital transformation through automation and analytics; and expanding global reach and operational excellence. The company also continues to pursue strategic acquisitions and integration initiatives to enhance its portfolio and capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: TD SYNNEX generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of IT products and solutions, as well as value-added services such as systems integration, logistics, cloud services, and financial services. Revenue is recognized at the point of product shipment or delivery, with less than 10% of revenue from services. The company also earns from marketing services, device-as-a-service, and recurring cloud-based offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: TD SYNNEX is one of the world's largest IT distributors, competing with global and regional players such as Ingram Micro, Arrow Electronics, ScanSource, ALSO Holding, Esprinet, Westcon-Comstor, VSTECS Holdings, Synnex Technology International Corp., and Redington Group. The company faces competition from both distributors and OEMs that sell directly to resellers and end-users, and is positioned as a leading global solutions aggregator with a broad, end-to-end portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For fiscal year 2022, TD SYNNEX reported $62.3 billion in revenue, nearly doubling from $31.6 billion in 2021 due to the merger with Tech Data. Net income was $651 million, with a gross margin of 6.26% and operating margin of 1.69%. The company has a large global workforce (23,500 full-time employees) and continues to pursue growth through both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TD SYNNEX differentiates itself through its comprehensive, end-to-end IT solutions portfolio, deep relationships with leading and emerging technology vendors, and ability to aggregate and orchestrate complex solutions for customers. Its value proposition includes broad product access, advanced integration and logistics capabilities, digital platforms, and expertise in high-growth technology areas, enabling customers to efficiently access, deploy, and manage technology to achieve better business outcomes.
